 Lakers get massive Luka Doncic injury news before Miami Heat game 
 2026-11-02 21:18 
 Luka Doncic has been cleared to play on the second night of the Lakers' back-to-back against Miami on Monday after scoring 45 points vs. Toronto, while Ziaire Williams is also set to return after being removed from the injury report.

 Slovenian star Luka Doncic is set to play on the second night of a back-to-back when the Los Angeles Lakers host the Miami Heat on Monday.

 Doncic sat out the second leg of the Lakers' previous back-to-back due to back tightness.
 After playing against the Portland Trail Blazers on Oct. 27, he sat out the following night's 103-87 victory over the LA Clippers.
 This time, Luka is not listed on the Lakers' injury report for the Heat matchup.
 That clears the way for him to play less than 24 hours after erupting for 45 points, 15 rebounds, and six assists in Sunday's 131-125 win over the Toronto Raptors.
 Doncic has been dominant to begin the season, averaging 37.7 points, 8.2 rebounds, and 7.3 assists through six appearances.
 He has scored at least 37 points in four consecutive games and currently leads the NBA in scoring.
 Los Angeles enters Monday's game with a 5-2 record and will be looking for its sixth win in eight games against Miami.
 Lakers also get positive Ziaire Williams update
 The Lakers received another encouraging development on the injury front, with Ziaire Williams no longer listed on Monday's injury report after dealing with a foot issue.
 Meanwhile, Adou Thiero remains out due to injury management.
